% Pattern: section/environment. \begin{section}{Title} ... \end{section} is a
% section head, and steps the section counter. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2.1 status=none
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 2.2 status=none
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{section}{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{section}
\begin{section}{Products} \label{sec:products}
\begin{subsection}{Finite products}
\begin{lemma} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{subsection}
\begin{lemma} Every product of bounded spaces is bounded. \end{lemma}
\end{section}
\end{document}
